faq: OnPini is the social game you play with the people you know. You each answer the same deck of questions blind, then see where you match and where you split. It’s not a dating app.
Friends, couples, crushes, family, classmates, group chats and fans. You need to be 16 or older.
Yes. It’s free to play, right in your browser.
Does the other person need to download anything?
No. Your link opens in their browser and they can answer right away. One free account opens the whole reveal.

The people you play with, once they’ve answered. Until then, neither of you sees a thing. Your decks also show on your page: from 18 they start on Public, so anyone on OnPini can play against your answers. You can switch any deck to Friends or Only me.
You’ll see how many answers match, like “Same on 6 of 10”. No winner, no verdict. Same answer, nice. Different answer, better.

story.metaTitle: Our story: why we built OnPini
story.metaDesc: Everyone’s connected. Nobody knows anybody. A few university grads from the Netherlands and Germany built the opposite: a social game with one rule.

items.d: Nothing shows until you’ve both picked. Nobody can copy you.

items.t: Nobody has to bring it up.
items.d: The hard question was never the problem. Being the one who asks it was. Now the game asks.
Answer once. People play your decks against your answers while you sleep. The more you play, the more of you there is to discover.
Every deck you two play stays. Months later it’s still there, right when you need it.

mission.title: Nobody you love gets to stay a mystery.
mission.line: That’s what we’re here for. It starts with two people and one deck. The more you play, the more you know, and the more of you there is to find.

story.note: OnPini (one word) is a trade name of GPM Holding B.V. in The Hague, the Netherlands. It is not related to PiniOn or other similarly named apps.
